mapper.select: SELECT growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", level_no AS "levelNo", level_name AS "levelName", min_exp AS "minExp", max_exp AS "maxExp", tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_levels ORDER BY level_no ASC

SELECT t.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", t.growth_level_id AS "growthLevelId", g.level_no AS "levelNo", g.level_name AS "levelName", t.total_exp AS "totalExp", g.tree_image_path AS "treeImagePath" FROM growth_tree t JOIN growth_levels g ON t.growth_level_id = g.growth_level_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
